name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: Exclusive native radio group with optional heading and per-item labels.

api.description: Exclusive choice group built on native radios. Compose RadioGroup with RadioItem children.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected value.

props.name: name
props.description: Shared native name for the radios. Generated when omitted.

props.name: label
props.description: Group heading. Wired as aria-labelledby on the radiogroup.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the heading. Wired as aria-describedby.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every item and sets aria-disabled on the group.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the group invalid and sets aria-invalid.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the group root.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. When set (or description is set), wraps in a label element.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text. Wired as aria-describedby on the radio input.

props.name: size
props.description: Override the group size for this item.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the field wrapper when labeled, otherwise on the control root.

groups.title: Accessibility
groups.description: Group name (label or aria-label): Pass label for a visible group name, or aria-label / aria-labelledby on RadioGroup when there is no visible heading.
